metadata.name: Audit (architecture & security)
metadata.description: Read-only audit of existing code: an architecture review, then a security review, then a prioritized report. Changes nothing.

parameters.label: Scope (folder or area)
parameters.description: What to audit. Leave empty to audit the whole project.

steps.name: Architecture review
steps.prompt:
Audit the architecture of existing code; nothing is being built. Scope: {{scope}} (if this still reads literally `{{scope}}`, no scope was given: audit the whole project).

Map the structure, then report boundaries and coupling, where responsibilities are unclear, fragile or hard-to-change areas, and the debt worth paying down first. Cite real files. Call return_value with your review.

steps.name: Security audit
steps.prompt:
Audit existing code for exploitable security flaws; this is not a diff review. Scope: {{scope}} (if this still reads literally `{{scope}}`, no scope was given: audit the whole project). Start from the entry points (network handlers, command and file operations, authentication, anything that parses untrusted input) and follow the data.

Apply the triage: only report what has attacker-controlled input, a reachable dangerous point and a known blast radius. Record each finding with session_metadata on review_findings (status: open), then call return_value with your findings, or `No security findings.`

steps.name: Report
